name: Mebex Tablet 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About MEBEX TABLET

MEBEX TABLET contains a medicine Mebendazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage threadworms (also called as pinworms) and other common worm infections of the gut (Ex. whipworm, roundworm, hookworm).

Initially, symptoms of gut worms may be mild or non-existent, but infections can lead to diarrhoea, stomach pain, weakness, anaemia (low red blood cells) and nutritional problems. You must consult your doctor if you do not feel better or if you feel worse after a few days of management.

Before taking MEBEX TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. MEBEX TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and should only be used under medical supervision in breastfeeding women.

MEBEX TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 2 years of age), therefore, consult your child’s doctor for advice. The most common side effect of taking MEBEX TABLET is stomach pain. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.
uses: Other common worm infections (Ex. whipworm, roundworm, hookworm)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEBEX TABLET

Manages gut infections like:

Threadworms (also called as pinworms) or
Other common worm infections (Ex. whipworm, roundworm, hookworm)
mechanismOfAction:
How MEBEX TABLET Works

MEBEX TABLET interferes with cell formation in the worm and causes structural damage in its intestine. As a result, its glucose uptake and the digestive and reproductive functions are disturbed, leading to immobilization, inhibition of egg production and death of the worm.
usageDetails:
How to use MEBEX TABLET

Take MEBEX TABLET as advised by your physician. You can crush it before giving it to a young child.

For Tablet: Swallow MEBEX TABLET with a glass of water.

For Chewable Tablet: Chew MEBEX TABLET before swallowing.

Your doctor will decide a proper dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and type of worm infection. Continue to take MEBEX TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Reduced white blood cells (reducing body’s defense against infections)
Allergic reaction (sudden swelling of your face or throat, unexplained wheezing, shortness of breath, hives)
Skin rashes (including peeling or blistering of your skin), itching, fever

warnings.details: MEBEX TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking it.
MEBEX TABLET should be used in breastfeeding women only under medical supervision. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy after taking MEBEX TABLET.
Do not take MEBEX TABLET if you are allergic to Mebendazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Use in Pediatrics:

MEBEX TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged under 2 years). It should be used in children aged 1-2 years only under medical supervision and if there are no suitable alternatives. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

name: Ivecop 12mg Tablet 1's
introduction:
Introduction About IVECOP 12MG TABLET

IVECOP 12MG TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking IVECOP 12MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

IVECOP 12MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of IVECOP 12MG TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. IVECOP 12MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IVECOP 12MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Parasitic infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues
Human scabies after previous management has failed

mechanismOfAction:
How IVECOP 12MG TABLET Works

IVECOP 12MG TABLET works by binding to the nerve and muscle cells of parasites leading to their death, thus helps to manage various parasitic infections.
usageDetails:
How to use IVECOP 12MG TABLET

Take IVECOP 12MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow IVECOP 12MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. But in children younger than 6 years, the medicine should be crushed before swallowing.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse IVECOP 12MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking IVECOP 12MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Diethylcarbamazine citrate (DEC) (used to manage lymphatic filariasis)
Warfarin (used to manage blood clots)

B. Drug-Food interactions:

Do not take food 2 hours before or two hours after taking IVECOP 12MG TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of IVECOP 12MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose include rash, urticaria, contact dermatitis, oedema, headache, dizziness, abnormal physical weakness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, fits, impaired coordination, breathing difficulty, tingling or prickling sensation in the arms, hands, legs or feet, decreased alertness, sleepiness or drowsiness, altered consciousness, coma, confusion, disorientation and death.

introduction:
Introduction About NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION

NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION Works

NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION

Take NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with NOWORM ORAL SUSPENSION to achieve better infection control.

Severe headache with nausea and vomiting, fits and vision problems
Signs of liver problems (such as yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark colored urine and/or pale stools, nausea, weakness, fever)

introduction:
Introduction About ABENDOL PLUS SUSPENSION

ABENDOL PLUS SUSPENSION contains a combination of Albendazole and Ivermectin, which belongs to a group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage infections caused by roundworm, infections caused by tapeworm, infections caused by pinworm, parasitic infections of the skin, parasitic infections of hair, inflammatory diseases, and other conditions.

ABENDOL PLUS SUSPENSION is used to manage parasite infections, which can destroy disease-causing worms and effectively inhibit the spread of illness. Albendazole manages the worm from absorbing glucose, resulting in energy loss. Ivermectin works by paralyzing the worms and causing them to die.

Before taking this ABENDOL PLUS SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have decreased blood count, severe liver, kidney, or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. The common side effects are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, and skin rashes. Get enough sleep, eat a healthy diet, and drink plenty of water. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ABENDOL PLUS SUSPENSION
Manage worms and parasitic infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ABENDOL PLUS SUSPENSION Works

ABENDOL PLUS SUSPENSION works against the parasite by managing it from consuming glucose and therefore depleting its energy stores and also causes the insect to become paralyzed, causing it to die.

Always take this ABENDOL PLUS SUSPENSION as instructed by your doctor. Shake well before use. Your doctor will give the right dose depending on your child’s age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ITIN 6MG TABLET

ITIN 6MG TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking ITIN 6MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

ITIN 6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of ITIN 6MG TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. ITIN 6MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking ITIN 6MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Take ITIN 6MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse ITIN 6MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as advised by your doctor. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: EVERMECTIN A Oral Suspension 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About EVERMECTIN A ORAL SUSPENSION

EVERMECTIN A ORAL SUSPENSION contains a combination of Albendazole and Ivermectin, which belongs to a group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage infections caused by roundworm, infections caused by tapeworm, infections caused by pinworm, parasitic infections of the skin, parasitic infections of hair, inflammatory diseases, and other conditions.

EVERMECTIN A ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage parasite infections, which can destroy disease-causing worms and effectively inhibit the spread of illness. Albendazole manages the worm from absorbing glucose, resulting in energy loss. Ivermectin works by paralyzing the worms and causing them to die.

introduction:
Introduction About IVERCID 3MG TABLET

IVERCID 3MG TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking IVERCID 3MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

IVERCID 3MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of IVERCID 3MG TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. IVERCID 3MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IVERCID 3MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: PRAZIJOL Tablet 4's
introduction:
Introduction About PRAZIJOL TABLET

PRAZIJOL TABLET contains Praziquantel which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintics. PRAZIJOL TABLET is used in adults and children (aged above 6-years) to manage Schistosomiasis, which is an acute and chronic parasitic disease caused by various types of blood fluke worms (such as Schistosoma mansoni, Schistosoma haematobium, Schistosoma japonicum, Schistosoma mekongi, Schistosoma intercalatum) generally characterized by symptoms such as fever, chills, cough, and/or muscle aches in affected individuals.

PRAZIJOL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Praziquantel. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from ocular cysticercosis (parasitic infestation of eye), epilepsy, and/or other parasitic infections involving central nervous system (such as cysticercosis).

Before taking PRAZIJOL TABLET, inform your doctor if you suffer from neurocysticercosis (parasitic infection caused by larval cysts of pork tapeworm), and/or have moderate to severe liver disease, kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and heart problems (such as cardiac arrhythmias/cardiac insufficiency).

PRAZIJOL TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as the medicine may pass through milk.

PRAZIJOL TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 to 18 years) and advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking PRAZIJOL TABLET are headache, dizziness, abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, urticaria (red itchy welts), and/or fatigue. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About BANDY PLUS 6MG TABLET

Bandy-Plus Tablet is an anthelmintics combination medication that is used in the management of various parasitic infections including scabies and lice and Intestinal worm’s infestations including roundworms, tapeworms, and hookworms.

Bandy-Plus Tablet is a prescription medication, and it is important to follow your doctor's instructions while taking it. It can be consumed with or without food, but it should be taken at a consistent time each day for maximum effectiveness. Do not exceed the prescribed dose, as it may cause harmful side effects. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, but avoid doubling up on doses. Complete the full course of treatment even if you feel better, as stopping prematurely may reduce the effectiveness of the medication.

Before starting this medication, inform your doctor about any other medications you are currently taking. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their healthcare provider before use. It is advisable to avoid alcohol, as it may increase drowsiness when combined with this medication. While it generally does not affect driving ability, avoid driving if you experience drowsiness or dizziness.

How BANDY PLUS 6MG TABLET Works

Bandy-Plus Tablet contains a combination of two medicines, namely Albendazole and Ivermectin which work together to eliminate parasites effectively. This powerful dual-action mechanism makes Bandy-Plus Tablet an effective therapeutic option for scabies, lice, and worm infestations.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicine before taking Bandy-Plus Tablet.

1. CYP3A4 Inhibitors (e.g., Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Ritonavir):

Interaction: Both albendazole and ivermectin are metabolized in the liver via the CYP3A4 enzyme. If you take drugs that inhibit this enzyme, such as ketoconazole, itraconazole, or ritonavir, they may increase the levels of albendazole and ivermectin in the blood, increasing the risk of side effects.

2. CYP3A4 Inducers (e.g., Rifampin, Phenytoin, Carbamazepine):

Interaction: Conversely, drugs that induce CYP3A4 (such as rifampin, phenytoin, and carbamazepine) can increase the metabolism of albendazole and ivermectin, lowering their effectiveness.
Effect: Reduced blood levels of both drugs, possibly leading to decreased therapeutic effects against parasitic infections.

3. Anticoagulants (e.g., Warfarin):

Interaction: Ivermectin has been known to interact with warfarin, a commonly used anticoagulant. This may alter the anticoagulant effect, either enhancing or reducing its efficacy.
Effect: This interaction can lead to either an increased risk of bleeding or insufficient anticoagulation, depending on how the interaction plays out.

4. GABAergic Drugs (e.g., Benzodiazepines, Barbiturates):

Interaction: Ivermectin acts on GABA receptors, which are also targeted by benzodiazepines and barbiturates. Using these medications together could potentially increase the sedative effects, leading to dizziness, drowsiness, and respiratory depression.
Effect: Enhanced sedative effects, leading to excessive sedation and possible respiratory depression.

5. Corticosteroids (e.g., Prednisone):

Interaction: Both albendazole and ivermectin can have immunomodulatory effects, and corticosteroids, which suppress the immune system, may alter the drug's effectiveness or lead to an increased risk of infections.
Effect: Corticosteroids may suppress the immune system, making it harder for the body to fight off infections during antiparasitic management.

6. Immunosuppressants (e.g.,Cyclosporine):

Interaction: Cyclosporine, an immunosuppressant, can interfere with the metabolism of ivermectin and albendazole by inhibiting CYP3A4. This could increase the levels of both medications, enhancing their side effects.
Effect: Increased risk of drug toxicity, including neurological side effects from ivermectin and liver toxicity from albendazole.

7. Antiepileptic Drugs (e.g., Phenytoin, carbamazepine, and phenobarbital, Sodium valproate):

Interaction: Some antiepileptic drugs, especially those that induce CYP450 enzymes, could decrease the effectiveness of albendazole and ivermectin.
Effect: Lower plasma concentrations of albendazole and ivermectin, possibly reducing their efficacy against parasitic infections.

Introduction About BANOCIDE FORTE TABLET

BANOCIDE FORTE TABLET contains Diethylcarbamazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage filarial infections, tropical eosinophilia and toxocariasis. It is also used to manage loiasis (eye worm infections).

Filariasis is an infectious tropical disease caused by any one of several thread-like parasitic roundworms.

BANOCIDE FORTE TABLET should be used with caution in patients with seizures and liver diseases. Contact your doctor before taking it.

BANOCIDE FORTE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking it.

BANOCIDE FORTE TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking it. BANOCIDE FORTE TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

There is only limited information available on the use of BANOCIDE FORTE TABLET in geriatric patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking BANOCIDE FORTE TABLET are nausea and vomiting. Contact your doctor if your symptoms got worse.

The safety and effectiveness of IVERSCAB 12MG TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. IVERSCAB 12MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IVERSCAB 12MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: ZENTEL Suspension 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About ZENTEL SUSPENSION

ZENTEL SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

ZENTEL SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take ZENTEL SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking ZENTEL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. ZENTEL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking ZENTEL SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking ZENTEL SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking ZENTEL SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZENTEL SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ZENTEL SUSPENSION Works

ZENTEL SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use ZENTEL SUSPENSION

Take ZENTEL SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking ZENTEL SUSPENSION once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with ZENTEL SUSPENSION to achieve better infection control.

Severe headache with nausea and vomiting, fits and vision problems
Signs of liver problems (such as yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark colored urine and/or pale stools, nausea, weakness, fever)

ZENTEL SUSPENSION should be used in children and adolescents (aged between 1-18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Use in Geriatrics:

ZENTEL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About IVERCID 12 TABLET

IVERCID 12 TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking IVERCID 12 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

IVERCID 12 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of IVERCID 12 TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. IVERCID 12 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IVERCID 12 TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About HETRAZAN 100MG TABLET

HETRAZAN 100MG TABLET contains Diethylcarbamazine which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage filarial infections, tropical eosinophilia and toxocariasis. It is also used to manage loiasis (eye worm infections).

Filariasis is an infectious tropical disease caused by any one of several thread-like parasitic roundworms.

HETRAZAN 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with seizures and liver diseases. Contact your doctor before taking it.

HETRAZAN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking it.

HETRAZAN 100MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking it. HETRAZAN 100MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

There is only limited information available on the use of HETRAZAN 100MG TABLET in geriatric patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking HETRAZAN 100MG TABLET are nausea and vomiting. Contact your doctor if your symptoms got worse.

Introduction About VERMIKIND 6 TABLET

VERMIKIND 6 TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking VERMIKIND 6 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

VERMIKIND 6 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of VERMIKIND 6 TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. VERMIKIND 6 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking VERMIKIND 6 TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ITIN A SUSPENSION

ITIN A SUSPENSION contains a combination of Albendazole and Ivermectin, which belongs to a group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage infections caused by roundworm, infections caused by tapeworm, infections caused by pinworm, parasitic infections of the skin, parasitic infections of hair, inflammatory diseases, and other conditions.

ITIN A SUSPENSION is used to manage parasite infections, which can destroy disease-causing worms and effectively inhibit the spread of illness. Albendazole manages the worm from absorbing glucose, resulting in energy loss. Ivermectin works by paralyzing the worms and causing them to die.

Before taking this ITIN A SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have decreased blood count, severe liver, kidney, or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. The common side effects are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, and skin rashes. Get enough sleep, eat a healthy diet, and drink plenty of water. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse.

name: Ben Plus Oral Suspension 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION

BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION Works

BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION

Take BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION to achieve better infection control.
sideEffects: Fever during the initial days of the therapy
Skin rash with redness and itching
Signs of low WBC count (such as flu-like symptoms)

Severe skin reactions (such as widespread skin rash, blistering, peeling or bleeding on any part of the skin with fever, chills, enlarged lymph nodes and malaise or pink or reddish skin lesions on palms or soles)
Severe headache with nausea and vomiting, fits and vision problems
Signs of liver problems (such as yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark colored urine and/or pale stools, nausea, weakness, fever)

warnings.details: BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION and for until 6 months after discontinuation of the therapy.
BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness after taking BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION.
BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for before taking it.
Do not take BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION if you are allergic to albendazole.

Others

Before taking BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you:

Have any type of sugar intolerance
Are a man planning to father a child

Use in Pediatrics:

BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION should be used in children and adolescents (aged between 1-18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required especially for very young children (aged between 1-6 years). BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION is strictly not recommended for use in infants aged below 1 year. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

BEN PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION

ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION Works

ANTHEL 200MG SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.

name: IVERACTIN 12 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About IVERACTIN 12 TABLET

IVERACTIN 12 TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking IVERACTIN 12 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

IVERACTIN 12 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of IVERACTIN 12 TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. IVERACTIN 12 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IVERACTIN 12 TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: OLWORM Oral Suspension 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION

OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION Works

OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION

Take OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION to achieve better infection control.
sideEffects: Fever during the initial days of the therapy
Skin rash with redness and itching
Signs of low WBC count (such as flu-like symptoms)

Severe skin reactions (such as widespread skin rash, blistering, peeling or bleeding on any part of the skin with fever, chills, enlarged lymph nodes and malaise or pink or reddish skin lesions on palms or soles)
Severe headache with nausea and vomiting, fits and vision problems
Signs of liver problems (such as yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark colored urine and/or pale stools, nausea, weakness, fever)

warnings.details: OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION and for until 6 months after discontinuation of the therapy.
OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness after taking OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION.
OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for before taking it.
Do not take OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION if you are allergic to albendazole.

Others

Before taking OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you:

Have any type of sugar intolerance
Are a man planning to father a child

Use in Pediatrics:

OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION should be used in children and adolescents (aged between 1-18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required especially for very young children (aged between 1-6 years). OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION is strictly not recommended for use in infants aged below 1 year. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

OLWORM ORAL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

IVERSCAB Z TABLET contains a combination of Albendazole and Ivermectin, which belongs to a group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage parasitic and worm infestations. Parasitic worm infections are intestinal worm infections that are caused by the ingestion of contaminated food and water.

Before taking this IVERSCAB Z TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a decreased blood count, severe liver disease, kidney or heart problems. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctor for advice before taking this medicine.

The common side effects are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, and skin rashes. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse.

name: Abiworm Suspension 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About ABIWORM SUSPENSION

ABIWORM SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

ABIWORM SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take ABIWORM SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking ABIWORM SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. ABIWORM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking ABIWORM SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking ABIWORM SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking ABIWORM SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ABIWORM SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ABIWORM SUSPENSION Works

ABIWORM SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use ABIWORM SUSPENSION

Take ABIWORM SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking ABIWORM SUSPENSION once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with ABIWORM SUSPENSION to achieve better infection control.

introduction:
Introduction About IVERCID 6MG TABLET

IVERCID 6MG TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking IVERCID 6MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

IVERCID 6MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of IVERCID 6MG TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. IVERCID 6MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IVERCID 6MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION

CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION Works

CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION

Take CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with CIDAZOLE SUSPENSION to achieve better infection control.

introduction:
Introduction About OLWORM PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION

OLWORM PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION contains a combination of Albendazole and Ivermectin, which belongs to a group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage infections caused by roundworm, infections caused by tapeworm, infections caused by pinworm, parasitic infections of the skin, parasitic infections of hair, inflammatory diseases, and other conditions.

OLWORM PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION is used to manage parasite infections, which can destroy disease-causing worms and effectively inhibit the spread of illness. Albendazole manages the worm from absorbing glucose, resulting in energy loss. Ivermectin works by paralyzing the worms and causing them to die.

Before taking this OLWORM PLUS ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have decreased blood count, severe liver, kidney, or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine. The common side effects are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, and skin rashes. Get enough sleep, eat a healthy diet, and drink plenty of water. Consult your doctor immediately if any of your symptoms get worse.

Introduction About WORMIN 100MG TABLET

WORMIN 100MG TABLET contains a medicine Mebendazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage threadworms (also called as pinworms) and other common worm infections of the gut (Ex. whipworm, roundworm, hookworm).

Initially, symptoms of gut worms may be mild or non-existent, but infections can lead to diarrhoea, stomach pain, weakness, anaemia (low red blood cells) and nutritional problems. You must consult your doctor if you do not feel better or if you feel worse after a few days of management.

Before taking WORMIN 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. WORMIN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and should only be used under medical supervision in breastfeeding women.

WORMIN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 2 years of age), therefore, consult your child’s doctor for advice. The most common side effect of taking WORMIN 100MG TABLET is stomach pain. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

Introduction About IVECOP DT 3MG TABLET

IVECOP DT 3MG TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking IVECOP DT 3MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

IVECOP DT 3MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of IVECOP DT 3MG TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. IVECOP DT 3MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking IVECOP DT 3MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MEVERTIN TABLET

MEVERTIN TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking MEVERTIN TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

MEVERTIN TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of MEVERTIN TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. MEVERTIN TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking MEVERTIN TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: ALBENDAZOLE 400mg Suspension 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION

ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION Works

ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION

Take ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION to achieve better infection control.

Severe headache with nausea and vomiting, fits and vision problems

Women of childbearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION and for until 6 months after discontinuation of the therapy.
ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness after taking ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION.
ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with kidney diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor for before taking it.

Are a man planning to father a child

ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION should be used in children and adolescents (aged between 1-18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION is strictly not recommended for use in infants aged below 1 year. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

ALBENDAZOLE 400MG SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About WORMDE 100MG TABLET

WORMDE 100MG TABLET contains a medicine Mebendazole which belongs to a group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used to manage threadworms (also called as pinworms) and other common worm infections of the gut (Ex. whipworm, roundworm, hookworm).

Initially, symptoms of gut worms may be mild or non-existent, but infections can lead to diarrhoea, stomach pain, weakness, anaemia (low red blood cells) and nutritional problems. You must consult your doctor if you do not feel better or if you feel worse after a few days of management.

Before taking WORMDE 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. WORMDE 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use among pregnant women and should only be used under medical supervision in breastfeeding women.

WORMDE 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children (under 2 years of age), therefore, consult your child’s doctor for advice. The most common side effect of taking WORMDE 100MG TABLET is stomach pain. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How WORMDE 100MG TABLET Works

WORMDE 100MG TABLET interferes with cell formation in the worm and causes structural damage in its intestine. As a result, its glucose uptake and the digestive and reproductive functions are disturbed, leading to immobilization, inhibition of egg production and death of the worm.

Take WORMDE 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. You can crush it before giving it to a young child.

For Tablet: Swallow WORMDE 100MG TABLET with a glass of water.

For Chewable Tablet: Chew WORMDE 100MG TABLET before swallowing.

Your doctor will decide a proper dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and type of worm infection. Continue to take WORMDE 100MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP

ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP contains Piperazine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintics. It is used in the management of ascariasis caused by Ascaris lumbricoides (roundworm) and enterobiasis (oxyuriasis) caused by Enterobius vermicularis (pinworm).

ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with kidney and liver disease and seizures. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP for your children depending on the age, body weight, and disease condition. There is no information on the use of ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP may cause side effects such as abdominal pain, diarrhea, dizziness, drowsiness, headache, muscle weakness, nausea or vomiting, and tremors. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP

To manage ascariasis and enterobiasis
mechanismOfAction:
How ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP Works

Piperazine is a GABA receptor agonist and binds directly and selectively to muscle membrane GABA receptors, presumably causing paralyzing of the worms; they are then dislodged from the intestinal lumen and expelled live from the body in the stool.

Take ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP as advised by your physician. Shake the bottle well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ANTEPAR 750MG SYRUP for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About WORMECTIN 12 TABLET

WORMECTIN 12 TABLET contains Ivermectin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiparasitic agents. It is used to manage parasitic infections like intestinal strongyloidiasis (infection in gut caused by a type of round worm called strongyloides stercoralis), infection caused by Wuchereria bancrofti in blood and tissues and human scabies (infectious disease of the skin) after previous management has failed. It is also used for the management of Onchocerciasis (known as river blindness, parasitic disease caused by Onchocerca volvulus).

Before taking WORMECTIN 12 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a condition called loa loa (eye infection) or have a weak immune system and taking any other medicines for other conditions.

WORMECTIN 12 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. Contact your doctor before taking this medicine.

The safety and effectiveness of WORMECTIN 12 TABLET in children weighing less than 15 kg has not been evaluated. WORMECTIN 12 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking WORMECTIN 12 TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, itching and fast heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: ABZ Suspension 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About ABZ SUSPENSION

ABZ SUSPENSION contains Albendazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthelmintic drugs. It is used to manage parasitic worm infections in the body. It is highly effective in killing pinworms, tapeworms, hook worms, threadworms, roundworms and whipworms in the body and provides relief from various intestinal and systemic infections such as enterobiasis, ancylostomiasis, hymenolepsiasis, strongyloidiasis, ascariasis, trichuriasis and giardiasis.

ABZ SUSPENSION can also manage worm infections of the brain (such as parenchymal neurocysticercosis) and liver, lung or lining of stomach walls (such as Chinese liver fluke disease, cystic hydatid disease) which are caused by larval form of tape worms.

Take ABZ SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking ABZ SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. ABZ SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women due to increased risk of side effects.

Both men and women taking ABZ SUSPENSION must use proper safety measures (such as usage of condom or contraceptive pills) to avoid pregnancy while taking ABZ SUSPENSION and up to 3-6 months following discontinuation of the therapy.

The most common side effects of taking ABZ SUSPENSION are stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, dizziness, headache and increased liver enzymes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ABZ SUSPENSION
Manage parasitic worm infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ABZ SUSPENSION Works

ABZ SUSPENSION is an antiparasitic medication. It binds to the parasite cell and disrupts their cell structure. It also collapses their metabolism and restricts them from absorbing sugar (glucose) which is essential for their growth and multiplication. This depletes the energy level of the parasite and causes cell death which in turn reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use ABZ SUSPENSION

Take ABZ SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not stop taking ABZ SUSPENSION once your symptoms subside. It is important to complete the full course of therapy with ABZ SUSPENSION to achieve better infection control.

Severe skin reactions (such as widespread skin rash, blistering, peeling or bleeding on any part of the skin with fever, chills, enlarged lymph nodes and malaise or pink or reddish skin lesions on palms or soles)
Severe headache with nausea and vomiting, fits and vision problems
Signs of liver problems (such as yellowing of the skin or eyes, dark colored urine and/or pale stools, nausea, weakness, fever)

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness after taking ABZ SUSPENSION.

Use in Pediatrics:

ABZ SUSPENSION should be used in children and adolescents (aged between 1-18 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required especially for very young children (aged between 1-6 years). ABZ SUSPENSION is strictly not recommended for use in infants aged below 1 year. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

ABZ SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking ABZ SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Praziquantel (a medicine used to manage parasitic infection of the blood)
Ritonavir (a medicine used to manage HIV infection)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. phenytoin, carbamazepine, phenobarbital)

Over dosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more ABZ SUSPENSION, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.
